class.name: PlayFabResult
class.description: Returned by PlayFab API calls to indicate success or failure. Check [member ok] for success. On failure, [member code] contains a machine-readable error code, [member message] contains a human-readable description, and [member hresult] contains the native HRESULT value. Native HRESULTs are signed 32-bit values and are sign-extended into Godot's signed 64-bit [code]int[/code]. For example, native [code]0x89235652[/code] is exposed as [code]-1994172846[/code]. Compare the unsigned HRESULT bits with [code](int(result.hresult) & 0xFFFFFFFF) == 0x89235652[/code].

method.name: get_hresult
method.description: Returns [member hresult]. See that member for the signed representation contract.

method.name: get_code
method.description: Returns a machine-readable error code string.

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns additional data associated with the result, if any.

members.member: The native signed 32-bit HRESULT sign-extended into Godot's signed 64-bit [code]int[/code]. Mask with [code]0xFFFFFFFF[/code] when comparing hexadecimal HRESULT constants.
Additional data associated with the result, if any.
